cohort: The cohort consisted of 166 women diagnosed with syphilis after 18 weeks of gestation who received adequate syphilotherapy and had both pretreatment and delivery titers.
finding: Maternal serologic response during pregnancy after adequate syphilotherapy varied by stage of disease, and failure to achieve a 4-fold decline in titers by delivery was more reflective of treatment timing than treatment failure.
gest_age: greater than 18 weeks at diagnosis, mean 29.1 ± 5 weeks at treatment
